newsitem.title: HONG KONG: CIL buys HK$40 mln outfitting business.
newsitem.headline: CIL buys HK$40 mln outfitting business.

text.p: Interior decoration materials trader CIL Holdings Ltd said on Wednesday it has agreed to buy for HK$40 million a business associated with the construction and outfitting of steel and concrete framed buildings from third party Sundart Engineering Ltd.
The company said the purchase would be funded by the allotment of 125 million new shares, or 26.3 percent of the enlarged share capital, at a price of HK$0.32 per share.

Sundart Engineering is involved in building-related activities primarily associated with the construction and outfitting of steel concrete framed buildings such as structural fire-proofing, design and installation of drywall and ceiling.
CIL said Sundart's owner, civil engineer Ng Tak Kwan, would be appointed to the board of directors following the deal.
CIL shares stood at HK$0.315 in late morning, down HK$0.005.
